verdicts.reason: Both candidates are the same broken layout. The checkmarks are cut off from their list items, which have shrunk to an unreadable cluster at the bottom right ('Legs / Chin Upper lip Ears...'). '$50' floats on its own beside the divider line, and 'ONE DAY ONLY TO SAVE' sits under the photo, away from the price it belongs to. The note-card panel has broken into stray tape fragments at the bottom, the photo is small and pushed to the left, and the reading order is jumbled. The only difference is a tiny change in the shape of the bottom-left tape, so neither is better.
